name: La Mare aux Oiseaux

dinnerNoteFr: Menu La Grande Migration, 7 temps (autres menus dès 95 €)

menus.name: La Grande Migration menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; with the 6-glass wine pairing €245 in all, or €235 with the alcohol-free pairing. Arrive by 12.45pm at lunch or 8.15pm at dinner

menus.name: L'Envol menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; with the 5-glass wine pairing €193 in all, or €183 with the alcohol-free pairing

menus.name: Le Reposoir menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner, with a choice of fish or meat; with the 4-glass wine pairing €147 in all, or €137 with the alcohol-free pairing

bookingOpens: Online through Guestonline on the restaurant's website, by phone or by email (accueil@mareauxoiseaux.fr).
dressCode: No set dress code; the restaurant asks guests to dress to suit the setting.
children: Children up to 12 have their own menu, Découverte Gustative, at €37.
duration: For the seven-course Grande Migration menu, the restaurant asks guests to arrive by 12.45pm at lunch or 8.15pm at dinner.
